storage: Small and slow: the crash layers (174,038 crashes, 345,152 people) are re-read monthly, unchanged layers skipped; raw.record grows only by changed versions, and the people never enter it.
ethics: Crash records may be republished with credit (COMPASS's open-data hub). The people in them go only to the restricted schema, coded and coarsened (age group, Idaho resident or not, coded citations; no sex), and are published only as aggregates.
